testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.tickdebugger.websocket.DebuggerTickWebSocketHandlerTest

testcase.name: transport error removes the client and unregisters from ingestion
broadcast sends to all open clients and drops closed ones once
connect registers the client and reports a thread-safe count
a failed send removes and unregisters the client once
connect is idempotent and does not double-register
close removes the client and unregisters from ingestion
broadcast is safe during concurrent connect and disconnect
